ideas.pitch: A real-time competitive programming duel viewer that parses Codeforces submissions and visualizes execution steps during knockout matches.
ideas.title: AlgoDuels Live Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Syntax Sprint is an individual offline contest with knockout matches; building an engaging live spectator interface solves the lack of immediate visual feedback for live audiences and judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated complexity analysis tool that statically evaluates C++ competitive programming code to estimate time and space complexity before submission.
ideas.title: CP-Complexity Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to competitive programmers by preventing TLE (Time Limit Exceeded) errors during high-pressure coding contests.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven upsolving companion that analyzes failed contest submissions, generates optimized alternative solutions, and explains edge cases.
ideas.title: Codeforces Upsolving Assistant
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the exact workflow of the participants at a Codeforces contest creates immediate utility and high engagement from the PYC Club organizers.

ideas.pitch: An offline-first, lightning-fast competitive programming template and snippet manager with instant hotkeys for standard algorithms.
ideas.title: SpeedCode Snippet Manager
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on raw execution speed and developer efficiency, matching the rapid pace of a 3-hour competitive programming event.

ideas.pitch: A local test-case runner and benchmarking utility for C++ solutions that runs multiple stress tests in parallel to catch corner cases instantly.
ideas.title: ContestBench Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a concrete pain point for competitive programmers testing against brute-force solutions under strict time limits.
